material_state.source_equilibrium_path: temperature rows follow the SVP curve; this is not a fixed-pressure or fixed-chemical-potential derivative
material_state.mean_flow_state: not resolved by the compiled table; must be source-verified before a model comparison

observable_contract.measurement_operator: u2 = omega/k for the resonant collective thermal/entropy-wave mode
observable_contract.physical_scope: full He-II two-fluid collective mode; not the normal-component shear channel and not ordinary first sound
observable_contract.measurement_family: resonance measurement compiled from independent experimental studies
observable_contract.frequency_or_timescale: not specified for the recommended Table 4.3 values; exact primary-record frequency and geometry remain open
observable_contract.measurement_amplitude: not specified in the recommended table; linear-response applicability must be checked against the selected primary record

main_reference_source.title: The Observed Properties of Liquid Helium at the Saturated Vapor Pressure
main_reference_source.publication: Journal of Physical and Chemical Reference Data 27, 1217-1274 (1998)
table_locators: Table 4.1 adopted database for second-sound velocity
Table 4.3 recommended values of second-sound velocity
main_reference_source.table_role: compiled recommended values at saturated vapour pressure; not a raw single-experiment record

derived_diagnostic.quantity: central slope of the recommended second-sound speed near 1.70 K
derived_diagnostic.role: candidate independent dynamic-response diagnostic only; not a UET prediction or a physical acceptance result
derived_diagnostic.uncertainty: not evaluated because the recommended-row covariance and row-level uncertainties are not supplied

independent_primary_crosscheck.title: Second Sound in Liquid Helium II
independent_primary_crosscheck.state_match: pressure path and temperature-scale correspondence to the NIST T90 SVP rows are not established from the abstract
independent_primary_crosscheck.use_policy: bibliographic/protocol cross-check only; do not combine with the recommended SVP rows or score a residual until the primary record is state-matched

uncertainty_contract.compiled_source_context: Table 4.1 lists source-level uncertainty statements for contributing resonance studies, but the Table 4.3 recommendation does not map a row-specific uncertainty/covariance to the adopted value.
uncertainty_contract.calibration_bounds: alpha and Z retain their existing conservative source bounds; e0 retains its existing conservative SI-scale bound; no joint covariance is assumed
uncertainty_contract.quantitative_pass_threshold: not set until a primary source row, state, frequency and uncertainty budget are locked

independence_and_holdout_policy.independence_class: different dynamic observable and measurement channel; the 1998 review compiles both equilibrium anchors and sound data, so statistical/source independence is not claimed

topic10_interface_requirements.reason: Topic 10 currently lacks an admitted coupled normal/superfluid velocity, entropy and thermal-wave eigenmode operator; the legacy scalar C/I plus scalar-gradient velocity map does not define this observable.
required_before_comparison: Core F0-F8 admission of state, ontology, units and equations
measurement uncertainty and numerical error budget
topic10_interface_requirements.openai_navier_stokes_role: methodological theorem-scope, norm and residual discipline for an incompressible normal-flow subproblem only; no direct model, parameter or evidence transfer to the coupled He-II second-sound mode

claim_boundary: This package identifies a state-bounded external second-sound response candidate and freezes existing He-4 matching constants. It does not provide a UET second-sound prediction, independent action-to-material validation, a blind holdout result, a full two-fluid transport tensor, or any Topic 10/Core dependency unlock.
